subject: [PATCH v6 19/19] selftests/mm: zap whole PTE tables in the khugepaged race harness

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged race harness to occasionally zap a whole PMD-aligned area of page tables, rather than just individual pages. This is done to simulate a scenario where a collapse walks the same table as the MADV_DONTNEED thread zapping it. The change aims to improve the test's ability to detect races between the khugepaged and the user space process.
